name: Century Spice Road
summary: Engine-building spice trading race where merchants convert low-value spices into sets claimed for victory points.
rules_text: Each player starts with two merchant cards: one produces turmeric, one upgrades spices. Upgrades move cubes up the track turmeric < saffron < cardamom < cinnamon. A market of six merchant cards and five point cards is face up. On your turn do one action: 1) Play a merchant card from hand to gain or convert spices in your caravan. 2) Buy a merchant card; the leftmost is free, others cost one spice from your caravan placed on each card to its left. Cards with spices on them give those spices when taken. 3) Claim a point card by discarding its required spices. First two point cards also give gold/silver bonus coins if still available. 4) Rest to return all played cards to hand. First to 6 point cards in 2-player, 5 otherwise triggers final round, then highest points from point cards plus coins wins.
rating_reason: Century Spice Road is turn-based resource conversion engine, fits engine primitives
